parameters.query:
SELECT id, name, website, industry, country, city, description
FROM public.companies
WHERE research_status = 'pending'
ORDER BY created_at ASC
LIMIT 5;

parameters.query:
WITH inserted_lead AS (
  INSERT INTO public.leads (
    company_id,
    qualification_score,
    score_breakdown,
    research_summary,
    business_model,
    identified_opportunity,
    recommended_solution,
    confidence_level,
    status
  ) VALUES (
    $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, 'researched'
  )
  RETURNING id, company_id, qualification_score, qualification_level
)
UPDATE public.companies
SET research_status = 'completed'
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING (SELECT id FROM inserted_lead) as lead_id, (SELECT qualification_score FROM inserted_lead) as qualification_score, (SELECT qualification_level FROM inserted_lead) as qualification_level;
